## Analyzer Architecture Summary

mlflow is a Kubernetes component. exposing 1 service(s) on ports\: 9137. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports\: 5000. connecting to external services\: aiohttp, azure-blob, gcs, httpx, mlflow, openai, postgres, redis, requests, s3, sqlalchemy, urllib. runtime dependencies\: MLflow, OpenTelemetry Collector, PostgreSQL, Redis. 219 Python package dependencies (167 required), categories\: 1 cloud-provider, 1 data, 1 image-processing, 1 k8s-client, 2 database, 2 llm-sdk, 2 numerical, 2 serialization, 2 web-server, 3 tokenizer, 4 web-framework, 5 ml-framework, 6 testing, 9 observability. Python k8s client with 499 API call(s). references components\: model-registry (import).
